ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify how to handle existing contracts that reference 'gas' terminology or whether legacy RPC endpoints remain available.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume legacy endpoints and terminology are deprecated but may coexist during a transition period. This assumption needs verification.

ambiguities.text: The term 'renewable' for mana is not technically defined - unclear if this implies different behavior or is purely semantic.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'renewable' is purely a naming rationale and does not change the underlying mechanics. Mana behaves identically to gas.

implicit_assumptions.description: All ecosystem tooling (wallets, explorers, SDKs) will update to use mana terminology.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Ecosystem fragmentation with some tools using 'gas' and others using 'mana', causing user confusion and potential transaction failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: The underlying metering mechanism remains unchanged - only terminology changes.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If metering semantics change, existing contracts with gas-based logic could fail or behave unexpectedly.
